title: It trickles from his jaws a fluid gold.

narrative.synopsis: In the midst of plenty, the gnawing pangs of hunger now made themselves felt; and the precious gift, which prevented his allaying them, soon lost all its attractions. His distress seemed so real, that Bacchus bade him go and wash in the Pactolus River, if he would be rid of the power which had so soon turned into a curse.

narrative.resolution: Midas hastened off to the river and plunged in its tide, noting that even its sands all turned to gold beneath his tread; since when, "Pactolus singeth over golden sands."
